title: X Tools
intro: I am an active X user and as such I am always looking for new tools that will improve my efficiency and use of X. Below is a short list of tools that I use and recommend.

tools.name: BackTweets
tools.description: Trace a link to see where it travels, who links to and mentions it, and the conversation around it.

tools.name: X Pro (formerly TweetDeck)
tools.description: A multi-column X client that lets you interact and converse on X more efficiently.

outro: While this isn't a complete list of tools, it is some of the best I have found. If you have additional suggestions, message me on X
